content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Ebooks nigeria

The term 'sovereignty-based commerce infrastructure' refers to a set of free and paid tools that give any digital creator full control over their online store, payment processing, and data ownership. COREMERCH's solution is not a workaround or a hack, but a permanent structural alternative to traditional platforms like Stripe and PayPal. By owning the entire stack, creators can deploy their stores quickly, process payments securely, and maintain data autonomy, even in countries where major payment processors are unavailable or heavily restricted.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

COREMERCH's architecture leverages open-source tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, and Supabase, which provide a reliable and scalable hosting environment for digital stores. Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script handle backend logic, ensuring seamless payment processing and order management. NOWPayments serves as the automatic on-chain crypto payment verification service, supporting over 300 cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee. This combination of tools enables creators to deploy their stores in as little as 48 hours and process payments without relying on traditional payment processors.
Who This Is Built For and Why

COREMERCH's sovereignty-based commerce infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators in countries where major payment processors are unavailable or heavily restricted, such as Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, and the Philippines. These creators, who often sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, software, and other digital products, face significant barriers when trying to collect payments through conventional platforms. COREMERCH's solution helps them overcome these challenges and establish a permanent, self-sufficient online presence.
Stripe's geographic exclusion list is a deliberate infrastructure decision — not a temporary gap waiting to be fixed.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a pre-configured solution that includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. This stack provides a robust and scalable infrastructure for digital stores, allowing creators to deploy their stores in as little as 48 hours and process payments securely. The stack also includes SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configuration for enhanced security and end-to-end testing to ensure a smooth user experience. With 30-day support, creators can rely on COREMERCH's expertise to get their store up and running quickly.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your digital store today, follow these steps: First, choose a domain name and register it with a reputable registrar. Next, set up a GitHub repository for your store's code and configure GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages as your hosting environment. Then, connect your Supabase database and set up Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification and deploy your store. Visit the COREMERCH shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to explore the Edge Commerce Stack and other solutions for your digital store.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Sovereign infrastructure means no single platform decision can cut off your income — the store runs under your own accounts.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
